news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 15% Last year net profit margin: 26% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (0.2% operating cash flow to total debt). Minor Risk Profit margins are more than 30% lower than last year (15% net profit margin).

news.title: Price target increased by 28% to ₹220
news.body: Up from ₹173, the current price target is an average from 2 analysts. New target price is approximately in line with last closing price of ₹225. Stock is up 30% over the past year. The company posted earnings per share of ₹16.92 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹30.20 (up from ₹16.92 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹15.7b (up 51% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.32b (up 79% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 21% (up from 18% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 15%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 26%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 16% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 11% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price gain to ₹204, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 11.7x. Average trailing P/E is 20x in the Consumer Finance industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 27% over the past three years.
